title: Strategy Taxonomy & Normalization
brief: Normalize all 433 MultiCam strategies + 762 registry strategies + 35 router algorithms into canonical taxonomy. Build equivalence map, capability matrix, physics profiles, cost models.

units.title: StrategyTaxonomyEngine
units.description: 3-tier taxonomy: category→family→variant. Normalize all strategy names across 7 engines into one namespace.

units.title: Strategy equivalence map
units.description: Cross-CAM equivalence DB: which strategies are functionally identical vs genuinely different.

units.title: Strategy capability matrix
units.description: Per strategy: required axes, controller features, applicable features, engagement control type.

units.title: Backfill existing engines
units.description: Update PartGeometry, CAMKernel, ToolpathGeneration, AdaptiveRouter to use canonical IDs.

units.title: Strategy physics profile
units.description: Per strategy: expected Fc range, ae/ap ratios, tool life multiplier, Ra range, thermal/chatter risk.

units.title: Strategy cost model
units.description: Per strategy: cycle time factor, tool wear factor, programming complexity, controller requirement.

units.title: Dispatcher wiring
units.description: Wire to calcDispatcher: strategy_lookup, strategy_equivalents, strategy_capabilities, strategy_physics, strategy_cost.

units.title: Tests
units.description: 30+ tests covering taxonomy, equivalence, capabilities, physics, costs.

closure_notes: Closed via CAMX-MS0-StrategyTaxonomy.test.ts (46/46 passing). StrategyTaxonomyEngine (1826 LOC, singleton strategyTaxonomyEngine) provides 3-tier canonical taxonomy (category→family→variant) with CamSystemId covering 22 CAM systems. Each strategy: canonical_id, display_name, category, family, cam_equivalents[], required_axes (3/4/5), engagement_control, chip_thinning, hsm_capable, applicable_features[], applicable_operations[]. 13 query methods (lookup, fromNative, equivalents, search, byCategory, byFeature, byFamily, byCamSystem, byAxes, stats, allIds, all, translate). Dispatcher wiring added: 7 new strategy_taxonomy_* actions in camDispatcher (enum+case+lazy-import). StrategyCostOptimalEngine + CrossCamRecommenderEngine + PipelineCostModelEngine confirmed as downstream consumers of cost and physics profile fields.
